repositories.description: GitNexus: The Zero-Server Code Intelligence Engine - GitNexus is a client-side knowledge graph creator that runs entirely in your browser. Drop in a git repository (Github, Gitlab, Azure, Local) or ZIP file, and get an interactive knowledge graph with a built in Graph RAG Agent. Perfect for code exploration
repositories.description_zh: GitNexus 是一个零服务器代码智能引擎，可在浏览器内为 GitHub、GitLab、Azure、本地仓库或 ZIP 生成交互式知识图谱，并内置 Graph RAG Agent，适合代码探索。
